sampling_parameters.sampling_strategy: Deterministic stratified random sampling across 10 difficulty strata

known_limitations: Annotation queue is a stratified diagnostic sample (500 pairs) and is not representative of random pair distribution.
Candidate pairs do not constitute matches; ground truth decisions must not be inferred automatically.
Missed-match audit demonstrates that ~39% of unrepresented OSM POIs have zero presence in Overture directories.
Cohen's Kappa is sensitive to category prevalence and class imbalance.
notes: Initial Milestone 5 human ground truth benchmark initialization.
